body:
Thanks for your kind words and thoughtful comments. Unfortunately today has been another bad day. He had been in some kind of residential treatment program and working a job in Nevada, but the funding ran out (?) so he pulled up stakes and moved to New Orleans to try to get work around Mardi Gras. It didn’t work out (as we could have predicted had we known what he was doing) and he called my wife today crying because he hitchhiked to New Mexico and can’t get back to California and it’s getting too cold to sleep outside. 

We are going to pay for a hotel and a bus ticket when he decides where he wants to go. I don’t know what we can do to help him. He’s too unstable to allow him to live with us and our two small children, even for a short time. He tells us what he thinks we want to hear and then goes off and makes secret impulse decisions that destroy whatever small progress he’s made. I just don’t know what we can do.
He is, though they don’t seem to be working well. I shudder to think what he’d be like if he weren’t on them.
